name: keaplayer
description: Lecteur multimédia de bureau, architecture modulaire inspirée de VLC

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run fixtures && playwright test
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis --publish never
